name: Absolutely Charming
source:
Hey!

Is that a new chocolate shop that you've somehow never noticed before?

You'd better go in, chocolate is always a good idea.

What??? The chocolate shop is magic and run by three attractive and somewhat mysterious individuals???

This you've got to see!

[From [url=https://tessabean.itch.io/absolutely-charming]Itch.io[/url]]
